Grade: PP2
Subject: LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: READING
Topic 3.8: Reading three to four letter words

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading three to four letter words, part of READING in PP2 LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: How do we blend syllables (3 HRS) form three to four letter to make words?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.
